_about: Enterprise-readiness plan P0 (docs/architecture/ask-agent/ENTERPRISE_READINESS_PLAN.md §7): multi-turn Ask cases replayed by tools/ask_conversation_eval.py through the live agent path inside a rolled-back transaction. Each case is a REDACTED derivative of a production turn (2026-10-22 audit) or of a client email in the owner's Drive folder (owner ruling O1) - no client, person or company name other than our own brands, no figures that identify a deal. Expectations are mechanical: forbid_brand (no published policy of that brand cited), route (model|fixed), all_points (flag points:x/y with x==y), forbid / require (case-insensitive regexes on the reply). A 'require' that encodes the plan's TARGET behaviour (owner line, brand line, clarifying question) is EXPECTED to fail on today's code - that failure is the baseline.

turns.message: can you fetch the above details & reframe the answer as per the cloudpe product ?

cases.source: Drive: client MSA review email with 17 points mixing MSA terms and CloudPe items

turns.message:
client sent these before signing the MSA, pls help me reply point wise

1. Contract term & commitment - confirm exact term/minimum commitment; whether at MSA, PO or service level.
2. Early termination - allow termination with 30-60 day written notice, or cap early-termination liability.
3. Auto-renewal - remove automatic renewal; renewal only with mutual written consent.
4. Data retention & ownership - minimum 60-day retention after termination with full data export; customer data and backups remain customer property.
5. Suspension for non-payment - formal grace period and notification before suspension.
6. SLA & support - share SLA (uptime, credits, severity, response/resolution, escalation matrix, maintenance notice).
7. Limitation of liability - carve-outs for gross negligence, wilful misconduct, confidentiality breach, security incidents.
8. Mutual indemnity instead of one-sided indemnity.
9. Refunds & service credits for outages and repeated SLA violations.
10. Security & compliance - confirm controls and certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
11. Backup & DR - frequency, retention, RTO/RPO.
12. Migration assistance on exit.
13. CloudPe audit controls - user activity logs, login history, admin action tracking.
14. CloudPe commercial discount - confirm the existing discount is protected for 1 year.
15. 10-15 days prior notice for impacting maintenance.
16. Pricing fixed through the committed tenure.
17. Payment terms - we are MSME registered, request a 45-day payment cycle.
